name: panel-nesting
description: 板材套裁与余料复用系统（Vue 3 + Fastify + better-sqlite3）

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.start: npm run seed --prefix server && npm run start --prefix server
